context: Asuka leads a small classroom; Sho-young engaged learner.
purpose: Teacher engaging young student in interactive lesson.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 翔くん、理科の実験、頑張ってね。
lines.en: Sho, you're going to do great on this science experiment.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging opening. Soft, steady voice. Leans slightly forward. The kind of teacher who makes a nervous child feel seen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: はい、集中して、観察します!
lines.en: Yes! I'm going to focus and observe carefully!
lines.style: Bright, earnest eagerness. Quick uptake on the 'yes.' Voice lifts with genuine enthusiasm. The particular conviction of a child who just understood something.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 気がつかないこと、ようけ、面白いよ。
lines.en: You know, there's so much you notice when you're really paying attention.
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful. Slight pause before 'so much.' Warm cadence—not explaining, but sharing something she's noticed about him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 判る!こうやって、変わるんだ!
lines.en: I get it! That's how it changes!
lines.style: Sudden bright recognition. Voice jumps with the realization. Small gasp of delight before the second sentence. The thrilled moment when observation turns to understanding.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 工夫、ようけしてみてね。
lines.en: Try a few different approaches and see what happens.
lines.style: Patient, inviting. Soft, open delivery. Not commanding, but gently pointing him toward discovery. Quiet confidence in him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 丁寧に、熱心にやってみる!
lines.en: I'll do it carefully and really try hard!
lines.style: Soft-spoken but determined. Slow, deliberate pace on 'carefully.' Voice settles into focus. The seriousness of a child making a quiet promise to himself.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ姿勢や、頑張ろうね。
lines.en: That's exactly the spirit. I know you've got this.
lines.style: Quiet pride in her voice. Calm, steady rhythm. A gentle nod lives in the tone. Recognition of his effort, not his outcome.
